svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Split-adjust the trend
svg.desc: Two stacked line charts over quarters Q1–Q16 with a demand strip above. Top panel: an observed CPU-ms-per-request series breaks at a hardware change (Q5, ×0.75) and a measurement re-grain (Q8, ×1.15), and a trend fitted through the breaks forecasts too low. Bottom panel: the same history restated on the current basis is a smooth decline and forecasts 0.759–0.733. Synthetic data.

text.tspan: Synthetic series (a −0.01 per quarter trend, invented).
No published time series of coefficient drift was found (Section 13).
